desc:
🎣 Start Fishing And Find Out The Hidden Truth About The Rod And Reef World!

Explore four living islands, from Verdantis to icy Winterspire. Catch extraordinary fish, unlock stronger rods, baits and boats, and complete your Index!

🏝️ Discover quests and hidden secrets.
🏁 Race boats and duel friends.
🐙 Escape the orca and face the Kraken.

Mythical Guardian fish carry stones sealing an ancient gate—and you're not the only one hunting them.

🖥️ PC
Hold Left Click: charge; release: cast
Left Click: reel / dial / attack
WASD: move / steer | Shift: sprint
E: interact | 1–9: hotbar
Q / E: dive / surface in water
Hold G: sense
F: block | Q: roll | R: lock on
Z / X: switch target
M: menu | B: map | J: quests | I: Index
Backtick: inventory | Period: emotes

🎮 CONTROLLER
RT: cast / attack | LT: block | X: interact
A: jump | B: dive / roll | Y: sense
LB / RB: switch item
D-pad: menus | View: map

📱 MOBILE
Use the on-screen buttons
